messages:
alex.garcia: Customer reported sudden 502 spike hitting hosted API /v1/generate from eu-west-1 around 09:12 UTC. They've attached curl repro and two trace IDs: trace-0a1b2c and trace-9f8e7d.

maria.kim: which edge tier? frontdoor or ingress-nginx? any LB code paths?

alex.garcia: frontdoor -> ingress-nginx -> envoy sidecar -> runtime pools. The spike correlates with an auth token rotation window, but error pattern looks like mid-stream connection resets (502).

ing-sre-bot: Alert: gateway_502_rate increased by 18% in eu-west-1 between 09:10-09:15. Top upstream: runtime-auth-proxy.

sam.patel: can you paste the minimal curl to repro? I'll try from a bastion.

alex.garcia: repro: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: tenant-42" \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate?model=gpt-large" \
  --data '{"input":"hello"}'
```
returns: HTTP/2 502

maria.kim: saw similar before when keepalive window exhausted on the nginx->envoy pool during token rotation. Requests queued then half-closed when upstream swapped keys. Does the customer use long-lived streaming?

alex.garcia: they're short requests but high RPS (2000rps burst). No streaming.

sam.patel: I repro'd one 502 from the bastion. Grabbed tcpdump on ingress host: lots of FINs from upstream just after request headers, then envoy responds 502. Logs: "upstream prematurely closed connection"

maria.kim: ok two hypotheses: 1) ingress-nginx conn window/keepalive slot exhaustion when auth proxy restarts 2) envoys doing active draining with GOAWAY + immediate connection close on queued streams.

alex.garcia: traces show 502s all map to same upstream host and same 10s window coincident with auth pod rollout. Trace snippet: trace-0a1b2c shows envoy 101->502 with error code "upstream connection reset".

sam.patel: mitigation: temporarily scale auth-proxy replicas + revert deploy to avoid in-flight drop. I'll try to add a 30s preStop sleep on auth-proxy to drain connections gracefully.

maria.kim: also bump ingress-nginx keepalive_timeout and proxy_connect_timeout on the ingress config as quick config to reduce thrash. Add small increase to keepalive pool size for nginx->envoy.

alex.garcia: steps taken: rolled back auth-proxy to previous image at 09:20 UTC; scaled replicas from 2->4; applied nginx tweak: proxy_connect_timeout 30s -> 60s, keepalive_requests 100 -> 1000.

ing-sre-bot: Incident note: error rate returned to baseline by 09:27 UTC. Postmortem candidate? :thinking_face:

sam.patel: capture: saved pcap, envoy logs, nginx status pages, and the failing trace IDs. Will attach to ticket.

maria.kim: follow-ups: 1) ensure auth-proxy deploys use rolling with preStop drain (sleep 20s) 2) add healthcheck to avoid remove of host while active streams present 3) add guarding rate-limit during token rotate windows 4) run chaos test in staging to simulate auth-rollover under burst.

alex.garcia: also propose a short-term routing fallback: route requests to a compatible lower-tier model when upstream auth health is degraded to avoid 502s for customers.

sam.patel: I'll open a GH PR with the preStop and healthcheck changes. tagging @maria.kim for nginx config PR.

maria.kim: thanks — I'll put mitigation and RCA notes into the support ticket and schedule a blameless postmortem if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
